test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

We were __took on__ the vineyards for a tour.
solution:
The correct answer is **'taken to'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in Past tense and it is a passive sentence. 
 
• So the right structure would be to use V3 form after 'were' i.e **'taken'**.
 
• The preposition 'to' is also not appropriate in this context.
 
• So the right preposition should be **'to' **as this preposition is used to indicate a destination or direction (in this case- the vineyards).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The preposition **'in' **is used to indicate time and position under certain conditions.

 
 
• Example- He is in his office right now.

 
 
• He put his hand in the jar.
 
• He will come home in January.
 
 
 
 
 
• The preposition **'to'** is used to indicate movement from one place to another.
 
 
• Example- He is going **to **Puri this weekend.
